name: Westbound Panama Canal "California Grill" Fire-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Goat Cheese Polenta
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Panama Canal Menu)
whyItWorks: Inspired by Walt Disney World's California Grill: ultra-lean pork tenderloin medallions served over smooth, creamy polenta.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the pork tenderloin medallions with mushroom/zinfandel jus on the side and take a Lactaid for the creamy polenta (or sub mashed potatoes/white rice).
watchOuts: Unaged goat cheese and cream in the polenta
Skip sautéed button mushrooms if sensitive to fungi
